reconstruction_gate.interpretation: Verified behavioral reconstruction only if all gates pass; absent historical final checkpoint hashes, no claim of historical message byte identity.

trigger.criterion: any selected linear-aware validation paired accuracy below 80%

data_manifest.fitting_data: Reuse only the previous query-conditioned study's 128 training and 32 validation families; no previous test family is fitted.
data_manifest.generation: Fixed greedy generator at seed 20261126 accepts 53 families after exclusions; first 32 used. This is not a combinatorial packing maximum.
data_manifest.views: Same fresh families, paired original/source/query/joint renderings, no independent-view sample claim.

uncertainty.method: Average four queries and three paired bridge/probe seeds within each family; resample the same whole-family indices for all contrasts/views.
uncertainty.scope: Descriptive intervals conditional on three paired seeds, not population-level uncertainty; larger controls and MLP are secondary.

accounting.probe_question_head_parser: Known public-text templates only; parser advantage disclosed

retention.larger_checkpoint_recipe: Full selected .pt states and normalization.npz in workflow artifact; regenerate source/pool states from pinned model and exported reconstructed bridges using feature manifest hashes.

limits: Behaviorally verified reconstruction does not prove historical final-message byte identity.
Probes get extra supervised fitting and public-question parsing; an accessibility gap is not an equal-budget superior-agent claim.
Larger raw/pool controls have unequal capacity and positional access; they cannot prove irreversible compression loss.
A failed linear or prespecified small MLP probe does not prove relevant information is absent.
Reuse of previous fitting data is explicit; only the 32 test families are entirely fresh after excluding 2,002 prior worlds.
Intervals are descriptive and conditional on three bridge/probe seed pairs; views are not independent samples.
